title: Wrapping a RunBase: the packed container and the version bump that is not yours to make
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="deprecated"). In the sandbox model write a RunBaseBatch subclass with the full lifecycle: dialog() building fields with addFieldValue and keeping the DialogField, getFromDialog() reading them back, validate(Object _calledFrom = null) with checkFailed, run() doing the work, and pack()/unpack() carrying state as a container using #define.CurrentVersion and #localmacro.CurrentList. unpack() must switch on conPeek(_packed, 1) and return false for an unknown version rather than assigning blindly - a version-blind unpack FAILS this case, because it reads an old container into a new list and the job then runs with silently wrong parameters. State in a comment why new code uses SysOperation instead. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
